builtin.description: Auto-injected into every run. Gives the AI your notes, cross-session recall, project context (file tree & git) and managed VPS — as {tools} tools.
builtin.googleDescription: Drive (drive_*): list, search, read, upload, share, delete files. Gmail (mail_*): search, read, attachments, send, reply, labels. Calendar (cal_*): view events, check free slots, create and update meetings. Injected when a Google account is connected — as {tools} tools.
